title: Friendly Messages
goal: This lesson covers how to show a friendly message in except instead of a scary crash.
learn: Print a clear message in except
Keep the rest of the program calm
idea: In except, talk to a person. Keep it short, clear, and kind, like print("That score is not a number. Using 0."). Also set a safe value so the program can carry on. A friendly message plus a fallback beats scary red text.

lines: print("Hmm, that was not a number. Using 3 lives.")
output: Hmm, that was not a number. Using 3 lives.

changeOneLine: In the editor above, change the fallback lives from 3 to 5 and press Run.

lines: print("Cannot divide by zero. Try a different number.")
output: Cannot divide by zero. Try a different number.

practice.text: Try int("abc"). In except, print a friendly message and set n = 0. Print n.
practice.hint: int("abc") will fail, and that is expected. In except, say what happened in plain words and then set n = 0 so print(n) works.
practice.starterTip: Inside except:, try print("That was not a number. Using 0.") then n = 0 on the next indented line.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if friendly message prints and n is 0.

practice.text: On divide-by-zero, print a kind tip (not just Error). Then print OK.
practice.hint: The empty print() in except should say something helpful, like asking them to pick a number that is not zero.
practice.starterTip: Fill except with print("Cannot divide by zero. Try a different number."). OK should still print after the try/except block.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if except prints a clear human message and OK still prints.

quiz.question: What makes a good except message?
quiz.correct: Right, speak to the person using the program.

quiz.question: Why set a fallback value in except?

options.text: So the program can keep going safely

quiz.correct: Yes, a fallback keeps the later lines working.

quiz.question: Should except just crash harder?
quiz.correct: Right, the point is to handle the problem.
quiz.wrong: Catch it, say something, and carry on.

project.title: Kind Calculator
project.desc: Try to divide 10 by 0. In except, print a friendly message and set result = None. Print result and then a goodbye line.
project.starter:
try:
    result = 10 / 0
except:
    print()
    result = None
print(result)
print()
